explanation: This method is vulnerable to SQL injection (CWE-89) because self.table, mType, value, and id are percent-formatted directly into the UPDATE query. Crafted values in value, mType, or identifier could alter the UPDATE statement and corrupt records. The repair binds value and id using $1/$2 placeholders in self._query(query, *args), though self.table and column name mType remain percent-formatted and self._query is not shown.
